name: Luciano Spalletti
prompt: Create ONE square illustrated face portrait of Luciano Spalletti, recognizable likeness as the Italian football manager. Style reference ONLY is the Christopher Nolan portrait: do not depict Nolan. Head and upper neck only, near frontal with subtle three-quarter turn, whole head and chin visible, small white margins, same head scale as reference. No shoulders, clothing, lettering, signature, watermark, frames or color. White opaque background. Elegant lifelike drawing, not photorealistic, no cartoon exaggeration.
